lines.zh: 长袍拖过石阶，我一步步上来。
lines.en: My robe drags over the stone steps as I climb.

lines.zh: 我绕着祭坛走，脚步很慢。
lines.en: I circle the altar with slow steps.
Ash settles on my cuff.

lines.zh: 我数着柱子，第七根旁停下。
lines.en: I count the pillars and stop at the seventh.
My hands stay folded at my chest.
The firelight moves with me.
I pass down the corridor without looking back.
My hem sweeps up a thin veil of dust.
I go around behind the holy seat.
The steps are steep, and I keep my footing.
I press my palms together and murmur a prayer.
Incense rises and curls around me.

lines.zh: 我闭着眼，听殿里的回声。
lines.en: Eyes closed, I listen to the echo in the hall.
The flame sways gently in the lamp.

lines.zh: 我在等一个愿意祈祷的人。
lines.en: I wait for someone willing to pray.

lines.zh: 我的手指在数珠上停了。
lines.en: My fingers stop on the beads.

lines.zh: 这座殿是我看着建起来的。
lines.en: I watched this hall being raised.
I look down at my own palm.
Wind comes through the broken window, cold.
There is a line I never finished.
Gold glints in the dark.
I reach up and trim the wick.
No one has come in a long while.
I stand like one more pillar.
This quiet belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我在想那件旧布该放哪。
lines.en: I wonder where the old cloth should go.

lines.zh: 你是来祈祷，还是来打断？
lines.en: Have you come to pray, or to interrupt?
Kneel, or leave.

lines.zh: 祈祷被打断了，脚步声很响。
lines.en: The prayer broke, and your steps are loud.
Your hands are not clasped.

lines.zh: 祭坛上的蜡已经烧到底
lines.en: The candles on the altar have burned to their stubs.
The moment you speak, the rite is broken.
I watch you without blinking.
There's no ash on you.
No weapons in this hall.

lines.zh: 祈祷被打断，火焰就会来。
lines.en: Interrupt my prayer and the fire comes.
Your breath stirs the candle flame.
I raise a hand for you to stop.
My recitation breaks for a beat.
Blood on the altar — a waste.
I grip the pillar and straighten.

lines.zh: 我的祈祷被打断，那就开战。
lines.en: You broke my prayer — then we fight.

lines.zh: 我的袍子被撕开一道口。
lines.en: A tear opens in my robe.
I raise my hand and gather the fire again.
I didn't retreat; I only paused.
You aren't worthy of dirtying this hall.
My breathing has grown rough.
Blood drips onto my hem; I frown.

lines.zh: 供品放在阶上，别递给我。
lines.en: Leave the offering on the step; don't hand it to me.
That won't buy forgiveness.
I accept it, and the rite goes on regardless.
What you brought smells very worldly.

lines.zh: 我低头看了一眼，没伸手。
lines.en: I glance down and don't reach.
An offering needs sincerity, not quantity.
I set it at the center of the altar.

lines.zh: 香火会比这个更让我满意。
lines.en: Incense would please me more than this.
You mean to interrupt me with this?
I shake my head, very slightly.
Don't touch my robe.
You struck the altar; step back.

lines.zh: 我的身子不轻，你该知道。
lines.en: My weight is not small; you should know.
A layer of ash lies between us.
You knock the censer; I steady it.
Your soles have dirtied the floor.
That contact is not an offense.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我就当你在挑战。
lines.en: One step closer and I'll take it as a challenge.
I put a hand out to steady the censer.

lines.zh: 你的肩碰到了我的袖子。
lines.en: Your shoulder brushed my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我已把自己许给了这座殿。
lines.en: I have given myself to this hall.

lines.zh: 我曾在另一座殿里立过誓。
lines.en: I once made a vow in another hall.

lines.zh: 祭坛前的两个影子并排。
lines.en: Two shadows stand side by side before the altar.

lines.zh: 我们只是同诵一段经文。
lines.en: We only recite a passage together.
No wedding, only incense.
I bow my head, and she bows hers.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一步的距离。
lines.en: One step of distance stays between us.
The gold is polished in the night.
That was a long time ago.

lines.zh: 这份安静我们不对外人说。
lines.en: We don't speak of this quiet to others.
I receive it in both hands.
I place it at the center of the altar.
I know this old cloth.
The weight is right; it's solid gold.
I wipe the ash from it.

lines.zh: 我不为财，只是要归还它。
lines.en: Not for wealth — it must be returned.
I tuck it inside my robe.
It's still a little warm in my hand.
I raise it into the light.
This doesn't belong to you.
You have broken the prayer.
I raise my hand, and the fire wakes first.
The doors have closed behind you.
I sigh, then look at you.
This is the road you chose.

lines.zh: 灯里的火全都朝我这边倒。
lines.en: Every flame in the lamps leans toward me.
I draw my hands from my sleeves.
You broke my prayer. Don't blame me.
Don't expect mercy in this hall.
My first phase is fire.
I take one step, and the floor grows hot.

lines.zh: 你毁掉的不只是一场仪式。
lines.en: What you ruined was more than a rite.
Your footsteps break off my scripture.

lines.zh: 我的声音在殿里叠了三层。
lines.en: My voice stacks three times in the hall.
Prayer interrupted — flame comes first.
From now on, you are an offering too.
Fire pours down from my palms.

lines.zh: 我不能让你带走这里的东西。
lines.en: I cannot let you carry anything out.
Fire chases along the floor after you.
I twist the fire into a whip.

lines.zh: 你躲到柱子后，柱子也烧起来。
lines.en: You hide behind a pillar, and the pillar burns.
I walk step by step; I don't run.
Flame circles at my feet.

lines.zh: 你身上的气味已经焦了。
lines.en: Your scent is already singed.

lines.zh: 我从你左侧过去，只用半步。
lines.en: I pass on your left, using half a step.
The air in the hall is all heat.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，那里没有出口。
lines.en: You back to the corner, and there's no way out.

lines.zh: 我抬手，火就从上方落下。
lines.en: I raise my hand and fire falls from above.

lines.zh: 铁甲先红，然后才烫到你
lines.en: The iron glows red before the heat reaches you.

lines.zh: 我把你围在中间，慢慢收。
lines.en: I ring you in and close slowly.

lines.zh: 这份耐力，我练了很多年。
lines.en: I have trained this endurance for many years.

lines.zh: 你在看我的眼睛，那里没有火。
lines.en: You're watching my eyes; there's no fire there.
Further in, and you reach the second layer.
I'm not rushed; there is no daylight here.
The fire is a part of me.
I set the whole floor alight.

lines.zh: 你退到烛台边，火就合拢
lines.en: You back to the candlestick, and the flames close in.
One last look at you.
A column of fire bursts from my palm.
I raise my hand and push a wall of fire.
That one caught your shoulder.
The ring of fire closes at your feet.
I press your chest; it's hot.
The recoil pushes me back half a step.
I clasp my hands and fire closes in from both sides.

lines.zh: 我的袖口烧着了，我不在乎。
lines.en: My cuff catches fire, and I don't care.
The burn drives you back several steps.
I rarely use this one.
The fire goes out, and I light it again.
I stand still and wait for you to come.
My voice rises above the fire's roar.
This is my reply to an interrupter.

lines.zh: 我站在祭坛后面，缓缓抬眼。
lines.en: I stand behind the altar and lift my eyes slowly.
Every candle lights at once.
This is the place I keep.
Ash falls from the beams.

lines.zh: 我张开双臂，像在迎接谁。
lines.en: I open my arms as if welcoming someone.
My robe settles with a soft sound.
I have waited many years.
The doors of this hall have closed.
I hear someone approaching.
The lamps spread out behind me.
I finish the last line of the scripture.
Then I lower my hands.
I bow once to the altar.
No one kneels this time.

lines.zh: 香炉的青烟先替我探路
lines.en: The censer smoke goes ahead to announce me.
The fire speaks before I do.
The old cloth still hangs on the wall.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看了看破损的顶。
lines.en: I look up at the broken roof.

lines.zh: 地板被我的脚步震了一下。
lines.en: The floor trembles once under my step.
The rite begins again.

lines.zh: 火烫到了我的脸，连我也怕它。
lines.en: The fire scorched my face; even I fear it.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上摔下，骨头闷响。
lines.en: I fall from the steps and my bones thud.

lines.zh: 水漫过祭坛，我念不出声。
lines.en: Water floods the altar and I can't speak.
The roof is torn open and light pours in.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的袖，钉在柱上。
lines.en: An arrow through my sleeve pins into the pillar.

lines.zh: 另一股神力压住我，我动弹不得。
lines.en: Another divine force pins me and I can't move.

lines.zh: 斋戒太久，我连火都举不起来。
lines.en: Fasted too long; I can't even lift the fire.

lines.zh: 雷击穿殿顶，正打在我的肩上。
lines.en: Lightning pierces the roof and strikes my shoulder.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，圣座也在下落。
lines.en: The floor is gone, and the holy seat falls too.
